item.title: Give Back to the Community with RPI’s VITA Program
item.description: RPI is partnering with United Way of the Greater Capital Region to launch a new Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) site. Gain hands-on experience while helping members of the local community prepare their taxes. No previous tax experience is required, and training will be provided. Interested? Attend the information session on September 30 from 1–2 p.m. in the RPI Union’s Ellsworth Room (3602).

item.title: A Control-Theoretic Perspective on Game-Theoretic Learning
item.description: ISE The framework of multi-agent game-theoretic learning explores how individual agent strategies evolve in response to the strategies of others. A central question is whether these evolving strategies converge to classical solution concepts, such as Nash equilibrium. This talk adopts a control-theoretic perspective by recognizing that learning agents interacting with one another form a feedback system. Learning dynamics are modeled as open dynamical systems that map payoffs, regardless of…

item.title: School of Engineering Receives Transformational Naming Gift for ECSE | October 9 Campus Celebration
item.description: This week, the School of Engineering celebrated a $27 million donation to the Department of Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering (ECSE) from Doug Mercer ’77. In recognition of his transformational generosity and long-term commitment to ECSE, the department will be renamed the Douglas A. Mercer ’77 Department of Electrical, Computer, and Systems Engineering. A formal ceremony open to the RPI community will be held on October 9. More details will be shared in the coming weeks

item.title: New Medical & Pharmacy Providers: Connect with Aetna & Express Scripts at the Benefits Expo!
item.description: Save the Date: 2026 Faculty and Staff Benefits Expo Join us on Thursday, October 29, from 10:30 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. at ECAV for the 2026 Faculty and Staff Benefits Expo! With RPI’s medical and pharmacy providers changing on January 1, 2027, representatives from Aetna and Express Scripts will be on hand to answer questions, share information and connect with faculty and staff.

item.title: Let’s Go Red! Champion Award — Who makes RPI feel like RPI?
item.description:
Some people have a way of bringing others together. The Let’s Go Red! Champion Award recognizes a staff member who embodies RPI’s welcoming, collaborative spirit and strengthens our community through teamwork, inclusivity, enthusiasm, and pride in RPI. Who makes you proud to say, “Let’s Go Red!”?
